page.overview:
Who is Squidmen?

Various other Squidmen|Enemies=Guardians of the Globe Rex Invincible|Only Appearance=2x07 "I'm Not Going Anywhere"|Status=Active}}Squidmen is a criminal group in Invincible that serves as a minor antagonist in Season 2.

Squidmen are easily identified by their grey squid like head and their tentacle arms with only 2 fingers. They wear a blue and black uniform with a black belt with a few pouches and objects attached. Squidmen can also appear mutated, the best example of this is Octoboss who has pink skin and is much larger than the average Squidmen.

In Season 2 they are seen attempting to break open a vault with a laser. Rex Splode arrives and fights with Octoboss until Invincible arrives to help finish the fight. After Rex Splode and Invincible stop Octoboss and the Squidmen the GDA shows up to arrest them.
